source: Hotspot 0
Large Doors
target: 大门

source: Sewers
target: 下水道

source: Robot Arm
target: 机械臂

source: Lock
target: 锁

source: &132 Okay, you're on the factory floor.
target: &132 好，你到工厂车间了。

source: &133 There's an emergency access route to the sewers in a corner of the North wall.
target: &133 北墙角落里有一条紧急通道，通往下水道。

source: &1625 Sure, except it's locked.
target: &1625 是啊，可它锁着。

source: &134 What?! This can't be right.
target: &134 什么？！不应该啊。

source: &1626 Yep. Big padlock and everything. Any other ideas?
target: &1626 没错，好大一把挂锁。还有别的主意吗？

source: &135 I'm afraid not. The crisis team's got the factory surrounded.
target: &135 恐怕没有。危机小组已经把工厂包围了。

source: &136 That's your only route out.
target: &136 那是你唯一的出路。

source: &1627 Guess I need to find a way to get the lock off.
target: &1627 看来，得想办法把锁弄掉。

source: &1628 That's the way back to the optics lab.
target: &1628 这边通往光学实验室。

source: &1629 Looks like the manual controls for the manipulator arm.
target: &1629 应该是机械臂的手动控制装置。

source: &1630 This is where synthetics are born.
target: &1630 合成人就在这里诞生。

source: &1631 How many metal...circles...do I need?
target: &1631 我需要多少个这种金属……圆片……？

source: Picked up: Metal Disk
target: 已拾取：金属圆盘

source: &1632 Whatever this is, building a synth apparently takes a lot of them.
target: &1632 不管是什么，造一个合成人显然需要很多这种东西。

source: &1633 It's nothing like the drones and synths of today.
target: &1633 跟现在的无人机和合成人完全不同。

source: &1634 Less personality, nothing to argue with. My kind of 'bot.
target: &1634 没多少个性，也不会顶嘴。我就喜欢这种机器人。

source: &1635 Are you kidding? If anything, that arm'd pick ME up.
target: &1635 开玩笑吧？那只机械臂说不定会把我拎起来。

source: &1636 It's already got one.
target: &1636 它已经有一个了。

source: &1637 The claws are jammed too close together to hold it.
target: &1637 爪子卡得太近，夹不住它。

source: &560 Though recognisably a padlock in certain parts, most of what remains is melted.
target: &560 部分地方还看得出原来是把挂锁，但剩下的大多已经熔化了。

source: &1638 This is a pretty heavy-duty padlock.
target: &1638 这挂锁可真结实。

source: &1639 Maybe it was an attempt to stop vandals getting in.
target: &1639 可能是想拦住闯进来搞破坏的人。

source: &564 The padlock's molten remains still glow from the laser's brilliant heat. Better not touch it.
target: &564 激光的高热熔化了挂锁，残骸还在发光。最好别碰。

source: &1640 Even if it wasn't a heavy-duty lock, the mechanisms have rusted shut.
target: &1640 就算不是这么结实的锁，内部也已经锈死了。

source: &1641 It's going to need something stronger than that.
target: &1641 得用更厉害的东西才行。

source: &1642 My escape route, apparently.
target: &1642 看来，这就是我的逃生路。

source: &1643 I'd better not be walking into an ambush.
target: &1643 最好别是让我走进埋伏。

source: &137 I haven't let you down yet, have I?
target: &137 我还没让你失望过，对吧？

source: &568 The door to another part of the factory.
target: &568 通往工厂另一部分的门。

source: The staircase leads back up to the laser lab, and the offices.
target: 楼梯通往上面的激光实验室和办公室。
